answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on the TL;DR dataset for text summarization... UltraFeedback dataset for instruction following... and also on MT‑Bench and ROCStory for out‑of‑distribution and story writing tasks.
answer_1.outputs: generated summaries, instruction‑following responses, and creative stories

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using both quality and diversity metrics. • RM scores... • N‑gram distinct... • EAD... • SelfBLEU... • Sentence‑BERT... • GPT‑4 win‑rate...

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT‑4 to evaluate the diversity by choosing the more diversity set... We also use GPT‑4 to perform pairwise comparisons of alignment quality...

answer_4.quote: The human annotators are asked to identify which set of completions is more ... (diverse) ... Human win‑rate...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two sets of completions and judge which set is more diverse (and/or higher quality).
